questions.question_text: One of the drug is excreted primarily by renal tubular sections. Identify.
questions.explanation: Carbenicillin is excreted primarily by active renal tubular secretion compared to other options.

questions.question_text: Identify one of the cancer chemotherapeutic agent which is an antimetabolite?
questions.explanation: 5-Fluorouracil is a well-known pyrimidine antimetabolite used in cancer chemotherapy.

questions.question_text: Agents useful in the treatment of bronchial asthma usually

options.A: Block both alpha and beta adrenergic receptors
options.B: Stimulate alpha receptors but block beta receptors
options.C: Stimulate beta receptors but block alpha receptors

questions.explanation: Beta-2 agonists stimulate beta receptors to cause bronchodilation, while alpha-blockers can decrease congestion, making selective beta-2 stimulation crucial.

questions.question_text: The antiarrhythmic drug Quinidine is:
questions.explanation: Quinidine is the dextro-rotatory diastereomer (stereoisomer) of quinine.

questions.question_text: Beta-Carboline ring system is present in
questions.explanation: Deserpidine and related Rauwolfia alkaloids contain the beta-carboline ring system.

questions.question_text: Licence for wholesale of drugs specified in schedule C and $C_1$ are issued in form
questions.explanation: Form 21B is issued for the wholesale of drugs specified in Schedule C and C1.

questions.question_text: The principal constituents Anethole (50-60%) and Fenchone (18-20%) are present in the volatile oil obtained from

options.B: Fruits of Foeniculum capillaceum G (F. vulgare)

questions.explanation: Fennel oil (Foeniculum vulgare) contains anethole and fenchone as its major constituents.

questions.question_text: Caffeine on oxidation with $KClO_3 / HCl$ gives :-
questions.explanation: Oxidation of caffeine with potassium chlorate and hydrochloric acid yields methylalloxan and dimethylurea (the murexide test degradation pathway).

questions.question_text: One of the following types of adverse drug reactions is not believed to be dose related phenomena
questions.explanation: Hypersensitivity and idiosyncrasy are Type B (bizarre) reactions which are unpredictable and generally not dose-related.

questions.question_text: Green bones are used for the preparation of a gelatin of the type
questions.explanation: Type A gelatin is typically derived from acid-treated precursor (often pork skin or green bones).

questions.question_text: In capsules, ROTOFIL is used for filling:
questions.explanation: Rotofil is a specialized machine used for filling liquids or pastes into hard gelatin capsules.

questions.question_text: Gelatin and glycerin are used for the preparation of lamellae in a specified ratio. Identify the correct ratio
questions.explanation: Lamellae formulations typically use a gelatin to glycerin ratio around 9:1.

questions.question_text: The Shick test is used to determine susceptibility to
questions.explanation: The Schick test is a clinical test used to determine whether a person is susceptible to diphtheria.

questions.question_text: One of the following general characteristics is not true for alkaloids?
questions.explanation: Alkaloids are basic nitrogenous compounds, typically having a pKa greater than 7 (usually between 7 and 11).

questions.question_text: Silver/Silver chloride electrode consists of

options.A: Metallic silver coated with a layer of silver chloride
options.B: Polished platinum wire coated with silver chloride
options.C: Silver wire dipped in a saturated solution of silver chloride
options.D: Two electrodes one of silver and other of silver chloride

questions.explanation: A silver-silver chloride electrode is formed by coating a silver metal element with a layer of silver chloride.

questions.question_text: In gel permeation chromatography molecules are separated on the basis of their
questions.explanation: Gel permeation (size-exclusion) chromatography separates molecules according to their size and hydrodynamic volume.

questions.question_text: According to Pauli exclusion principle, spins of two electrons in the same orbital are
questions.explanation: Pauli exclusion principle states that two electrons in the same orbital must have opposite spins (+1/2 and -1/2).

questions.question_text: Vaccines and toxoids are precipitated and absorbed on to aluminium hydroxide or other suitable media. This process results in a dosage form that in comparison to fluid forms
questions.explanation: Adsorbed (depot) vaccines release the antigen slowly, thereby prolonging and enhancing the immune response.

questions.question_text: In order to produce characteristic pharmacological action, a drug must always

options.C: Achieve adequate concentration at the site of action

questions.explanation: A drug must achieve an effective therapeutic concentration at its specific site of action to elicit its pharmacological response.

questions.question_text: The Wurster process can be used to
questions.explanation: The Wurster process is an air-suspension coating technique widely used for microencapsulation of particles and coating tablets/pellets.
